objective: Determine whether the layer-0 c1/c2 cache-state divergence localized by R85 begins in projected prefill inputs or inside the XPU GDN prefill kernels.

instrumentation.scope: First pure-prefill call per GDN layer and prefill request-count shape in each TP process.
payload_per_request: prefill request index and token indices
SHA-256, shape, and dtype of projected qkvz rows
SHA-256, shape, and dtype of projected ba rows

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

decision: Compare c1 request 0 with c2 request 0 within each TP rank. If layer-0 qkvz and ba both match, localize to GDN prefill arithmetic. If qkvz differs while ba matches, localize to the qkvz projection. If both differ, trace the layer-0 hidden input before modifying arithmetic.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. Device-to-host hashing synchronizes execution and invalidates throughput measurement.
